title: Telnet standards used by TN5250/TN5250E
summary: TN5250 is layered on Telnet. Keep the generic Telnet option standards available so byte-level negotiation is derived from the actual option specifications rather than copied traces.

references.name: RFC 885 Telnet End of Record Option
references.use: EOR record boundary used by TN5250

invariants: Do not infer Telnet escaping or option state solely from a packet capture.
5250 logical-record parsing begins only after Telnet negotiation/escaping and EOR framing are handled correctly.
